objective: Reduce the two per-candidate high-risk class-audit calls without weakening the production visual evidence, semantic decision, or candidate/truth/training boundary.

experiments.actual_change: Concatenate the original and marked crops into one JPEG evidence card and update only the image-layout sentence in the prompt.
experiments.naming_note: The historical experiment key says lossless, but the card was JPEG encoded at quality 92. It therefore changed pixel encoding as well as layout and is not a lossless production-equivalent input.
experiments.failure: Candidate 14 changed from supported person to uncertain mixed objects; candidate 15 changed from conflict to uncertain.

experiments.actual_change: Keep the production prompt, schema, original crop, marked crop, and two-image order byte-identical; reduce only max_tokens from 768 to 384.
experiments.finding: Both responses already stopped naturally at 123 and 127 completion tokens, so lowering an unused cap did not reduce generated output and the observed total latency was slower.

acceptance_gate.required: Full semantic-core equality, no truncation, unchanged evidence, and a meaningful replicated latency reduction.
acceptance_gate.reason: The one-image route failed semantic equality and the production-equivalent 384-token route was 9.917 percent slower in this bounded check.

boundaries: This is a bounded two-candidate engineering experiment, not an accuracy benchmark.
No formal candidate, human truth, training approval, model weight, OSS object, or runtime configuration was modified.
The rejected variants remain isolated evidence and are not production behavior.
